## Steps

<figure class="story-hero"><a href="/forge-studio/media/stories/S5/01-open-studio-on-the-agents-pillar.png"><img src="/forge-studio/media/stories/S5/01-open-studio-on-the-agents-pillar.png" alt="1. Open Studio on the Agents pillar"></a></figure>

1. **Open Studio on the Agents pillar.** The Agents pillar lists every agent forge can dispatch.
2. **Press "+ New agent".** A new agent starts from a starter — a ready-made shape the operator edits — or from nothing at all.
3. **Start from the Blank agent starter, name it "story S5", and say what it exists to do.** Every agent needs one sentence that says why it exists, because that sentence is what a planner reads when it decides which agent to put at a station.
4. **Write the instructions: what this agent does, step by step.** The purpose says why this agent exists; the instructions say how it works, and forge hands that body to the agent as its brief at dispatch time.
5. **Open Advanced and compose the two skills this agent needs.** Composing is the whole idea: an agent is not written, it is assembled out of skills the library already holds.
6. **Set the tool fence: this agent may invoke git and Node, and nothing else.** The fence is the point of the Advanced drawer.
7. **Leave the MCP zone empty — the fence is a closed list, not a starting point.** This agent talks to a repo and a browser.
8. **Save the agent.** Saving mints the agent and lands the operator on its own page.
9. **Check the agent is ready — every readiness check the panel names.** Readiness is forge refusing to pretend.
10. **Cap what this run may spend at $2.** A real agent costs real money, so the operator sets the cap before starting the run rather than discovering the bill afterwards — and the button says the figure back to them.
11. **Run the agent standalone against the story's own project.** Standalone is an agent off the graph: no Flow, no station, just this agent against this project because the operator asked.
12. **Watch the run land in the agent’s own history.** Every dispatch this agent has ever had is on its own page.
13. **Read the row: what it cost, where it ran, and how it ended.** This is where S5 ends, and the word that matters is honest.
